tagline: Keep data in sync between Airtable bases and Notion databases
metaTitle: Airtable Notion Integration: Two-Way Record and Status Sync
metaDescription: Sync Airtable records to Notion pages and Notion tasks to Airtable, with status fields matched both ways. GAIA prevents duplicates. See the setup steps.
intro:
Teams often use Airtable for structured data management and Notion for documentation and project planning, resulting in duplicate data entry when the same information needs to live in both. A CRM record updated in the base never appears on the client page, and tasks added to a project database don't appear in the operations tracker.

GAIA syncs the two so data moves automatically between the base and the workspace. Record updates in Airtable propagate to the corresponding database entries in Notion, and status changes on a page update the linked records. Teams maintain one source of truth without choosing between the two tools they rely on.

useCases.title: Sync Airtable CRM records to Notion client pages
useCases.description: When a client record is updated in Airtable, GAIA updates the corresponding client page with the latest status, owner, and notes. Both tools reflect the same information without duplicate entry.

useCases.title: Mirror Notion project tasks to Airtable
useCases.description: Tasks created in a project database are automatically added to the operations base. Operations teams track all work in that base while project managers work in Notion.

useCases.title: Sync status fields bidirectionally
useCases.description: A status change in the base is applied to the linked database record, and a change in the database is applied to the base record. Teams working in either tool always see current status without manual reconciliation.

useCases.title: Aggregate base data in dashboard pages
useCases.description: GAIA pulls summary metrics from the base (counts, sums, averages) and updates the dashboard pages daily. Leadership sees live operational data inside their workspace.

howItWorks.step: Connect Airtable and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Airtable account and Notion workspace. GAIA maps table fields to database properties for each sync pair you configure.

howItWorks.step: Configure field mappings and sync direction
howItWorks.description: Define which fields sync and whether sync is one-way or bidirectional. GAIA handles field type translation between the two tools.

howItWorks.step: Let GAIA keep both sides in sync
howItWorks.description: Record changes on either side are mirrored to the other according to your mappings. Data stays consistent without anyone manually updating two systems.

faqs.question: How does GAIA handle field type differences between Airtable and Notion?
faqs.answer: GAIA translates common field types automatically — select fields in the base map to select properties in the database, and date fields map to date properties. Custom mappings are available for edge cases.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync record attachments to pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. Attachment fields can be synced to file and media properties in the database. Files are transferred and linked so both records reference the same assets.

faqs.question: Does bidirectional sync risk creating duplicate records?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA assigns unique identifiers to synced records and tracks origin to prevent duplication. Records updated on either side update their counterpart rather than creating a new entry.
